authority: owner-delegated licence-reviewed public asset selection, decision 0019
caveats: The guard project is archived/unmaintained; no operational support or quality guarantee is inferred.
Published benchmark metrics are publisher reports and were not reproduced.
Listed training sources and unknown additional sources remain contamination/provenance risks; do not claim an unseen confirmatory set without a separate audit.
The example code truncates at 512 tokens. It must not be copied into this study; complete-input chunking and mask semantics must be qualified.
licence_observations: Pinned guard card and LICENSE agree on Apache-2.0 for the published model.
Pinned Microsoft base-model card declares MIT; the linked official code repository has retained MIT terms and copyright notice.
No conflicting model-specific or gated terms were observed in these reviewed files.
Selection relies on the publishers express model licence grants; it does not establish rights to every upstream training-data record.
The guard card labels some unlicensed datasets public domain without naming them. That assertion is not adopted and those data are not approved for acquisition or reuse.
planned_runtime: standard pinned ONNX Runtime and tokenizer library; no remote Python code or pickle loading
purpose: bounded public/synthetic-input research comparison of a fixed task-matched guard

download to fresh local root under remaining storage cap and verify advertised byte hashes
pin tokenizer files and inspect complete-input/token-mask coverage
execute actual short/long-input CPU guard comparison within recorded budget
complete source/split/label-audit and final measurement dossier
